patch_submodule_attribute: create a patch_submodule instance to replace os.path.join with a custom function in a module
use_patch_as_context_manager: use patch_submodule as a context manager to temporarily patch a submodule attribute and restore it on exit
start_stop_patch_manually: call start and stop on a patch_submodule instance to manually activate and deactivate a patch
patch_builtin_function: patch a builtin like open in a module object using patch_submodule
review_PatchedModuleObj: review the _PatchedModuleObj class that wraps a module and exposes its public attributes as instance attributes
